retrieval_rules.disease_information: Use WHO or relevant official Indian health sources for general disease information.
retrieval_rules.vaccination_information: Prefer the latest Government of India Ministry of Health and Family Welfare schedule.
retrieval_rules.vitamin_a_information: Use the Government of India National Immunization Schedule and keep Vitamin A separate from vaccines.
retrieval_rules.outbreak_information: Use verified NCDC IDSP/IHIP surveillance information only.
retrieval_rules.conflicting_information: For India-specific public-health programmes, prefer the latest applicable Government of India guidance.
retrieval_rules.outdated_information: Do not use information whose validity cannot be established when a newer official source is available.

critical_notes: Government of India sources should take priority for India-specific vaccination and outbreak information.
WHO may be used for general disease information, symptoms, prevention and risk information.
The chatbot must not treat an LLM-generated statement as a healthcare source.
Healthcare claims should retain source information wherever possible.
Outbreak information must be verified before being presented as a real alert.
Demo outbreak data must never be presented as real-world surveillance data.
Source information should be periodically re-verified because healthcare guidelines and surveillance information can change.
response_restrictions: Do not invent vaccination dates, vaccine doses or schedules.
Do not invent outbreak locations, case counts, alert levels or dates.
Do not diagnose a disease based only on symptoms.
Do not prescribe medication or individualized medication dosages.
Do not create personalized vaccination catch-up schedules.
Do not present unverified outbreak information as fact.
Do not present prototype or DEMO data as real-world health information.
For emergency symptoms, prioritize seeking professional medical care.
When sources conflict, prefer the latest applicable official Government of India guidance for India-specific programmes.

rag_source_format.recommended_response_attribution: According to the referenced healthcare source...
